summary:
The 4th Marine Regiment (Amf 4), based in Gothenburg, was re-established in 2021 after being disbanded in 2004. It originated in 2000, when Älvsborg Coastal Artillery Regiment was reorganized as a marine regiment following the formation of the Swedish Amphibious Corps. The 2004 Defence Act retained the 1st Marine Regiment in Vaxholm as the sole training platform, while Amf 4 was disbanded; a Gothenburg detachment continued operating with units from the 1st Marine Regiment and the Naval Base.

Reinstated on 1 October 2021, Amf 4 initially comprised nearly 600 employees and 300 conscripts. Its formation included the existing 17th Patrol Boat Company and 132nd Naval Security Company, as well as a newly established 5th Amphibious Battalion. The regiment’s current units are the 5th Marine Battalion, 17th Patrol Boat Company and 132nd Naval Security Company. Its planned long-term strength is about 900 employees and 300 conscripts.
